card.name: Codes and shortcuts before a final letter
card.fires_on: Partway through codes, keyboard shortcuts and odd strings, where a single letter or digit is expected next. Seen at the plus sign in Shift+ or Ctrl+ shortcuts, inside URL numbers and hex colors, and inside a drug name stem.

modes.label: Keyboard shortcuts
modes.description: The plus sign after Shift, Control or Cmd/Ctrl, just before the shortcut letter or digit.

modes.label: Codes and URLs
modes.description: A digit or letter inside a URL number, hex color or plant symbol, just before the last character.

modes.label: Inside a drug or abbreviation
modes.description: Partway through a drug name suffix or a dotted abbreviation like b.i.d.
modes.example: serious hypersensitivity to erenumab-a<<oo>>e or to any

card.writes: It promotes single-letter pieces that start the next short chunk, so it pushes a lone letter to follow.
card.plain: It fires inside codes, links and shortcut keys, where one more letter or number comes next.
